displayName: OCI-AUTH-001: Authentication — Brute Force Login Attempts
description:
Detects high volume of failed authentication attempts from a single source IP indicating brute force attack

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_auth_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%authentication%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%brute%') AND "value" > 0
